title: Manus vs Metal: finished tasks and recurring roles
h1: manus vs Metal: a task service or bots you keep
description: Compare Manus credits, cloud tasks and automation limits with Metal roles and separate AI billing, without guessing a cost per task.
answer: **want a finished deck or a colleague for the next brief too?** manus produces research, websites and slides in its cloud computers.[^1] dusk bots keep lasting jobs, chats and memory. manus bundles models into credit plans; dusk separates hosting from your ai bill.[^2][^5] choose the handoff you want, then try the same small brief before paying for more.
og_line: task credits and bot costs, explained.

them: you want a hosted task to produce research, slides or a website
you want models inside a credit plan instead of a separate ai bill
dusk: you want bots that keep their jobs and memory between tasks
you want to choose an ai per bot and decide on hosting separately

method:
**Metal is based on Dusk Bot. we haven't run the same brief through both.** this compares manus's product and pricing as of 12 november 2026 with dusk docs.

we cannot price an identical report in manus credits or name a winner for research accuracy and finished files.

sections.h: a finished task or a lasting role
sections.md:
**start with what you want to hand over.** manus offers research, websites, slides, images and video.[^1] its telegram post also describes recurring summaries.[^3]

dusk keeps a bot's job and editable memory between tasks. change its ai and the chats, files and memory stay.[^4] try an ongoing reviewer if that suits your work.

use the [research brief](/use-cases/market-research) to narrow the task. manus said on 1 september 2026 that it resumed independent operations.[^12]

**run your brief once and watch the credits it eats.** as of 12 november 2026, manus lists:[^2]

- free: 300 daily credits, separate from the monthly pools
- pro: $20/month and 4,000 monthly credits
- max: $200/month and 40,000 monthly credits, then pay as you go

that gives you the allowance, but only a trial tells you what your report consumes.

dusk's bill has two parts: the machine and ai. personal local use is free; cloud plus is $20/month and pro $50/month. your provider bills ai.[^5][^8] work needs a license; cloud pro includes one for one person.[^8][^11] put every line in the [cost guide](/guides/how-much-does-an-ai-agent-cost).

**get the unanswered questions before they reach the client.** give both products a few proposals and your requirements. ask for file evidence beside each claim, with missing answers left open. read the claims against the files.

for dusk, start with attachments. inspect notes under memory, or turn off let this bot use memory.[^10] ask for the source file even when the bot remembers the context. see [manus alternatives](/alternatives/manus) for other ways to hand over the work.

faq.q: how many free credits does manus ai give?
faq.a: **300 a day, as of 12 november 2026.** free includes manus 2.0 lite, 3 tasks at once and 2 automations. that does not tell you how many of your tasks will finish.[^2]

faq.q: what should i compare before switching from manus?
faq.a: **test the work you actually repeat.** compare the same narrow brief, sources, usage and where files live. we have not run that comparison, so we cannot name a quality or cost winner.

faq.q: can i message manus from telegram?
faq.a: **yes.** its launch post describes linking telegram and getting recurring summaries there.[^3] dusk has its own desktop and paired phone interface. store phone apps are still on the way.[^7]
